name: Stipop
all_locations: Los Angeles, CA, USA; Santa Monica, CA, USA
long_description:
Stipop is a monetization platform for character creators, or simply put, Patreon for character creators. We help independent character IP owners generate revenue directly from their audience with fun, dynamic features. 

Previously, Stipop was a sticker platform with 5,000 sticker creators, and 250K stickers and provided stickers to Canva, Teams, Google, and Adobe. We also provide sticker API and SDK to help chat apps improve revenue and user engagement.

Stipop has been invested by Snap (through Yellow Accelerator), YC, Translink Investment, Strong Ventures, Next Ventures, and more.

launches.title: Stipop: A must-have sticker feature in modern communication
launches.tagline: Increase user engagement and retention with Stipop - Install stickers in a day!
launches.body:
Hi everyone [👋](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand/#:\~:text=A%20hand%20waving%20most%20commonly,to%20Emoji%201.0%20in%202015.) [Tony](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tonypark-stipop/) and [Daniel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/danielcho6/) here to introduce [Stipop](https://stipop.io/en/)!

Stipop provides an **easy-to-install sticker API and SDK** to help you install a complete sticker feature within minutes. It includes 150K+ unique stickers designed by thousands of creators, a pre-built and customizable user interface and a sticker search engine.

### **Why stickers in modern communication?**

Online communication has become ever more important and users are always looking for ways to express their thoughts and emotions better. That’s why stickers are now used 17x more than GIFs worldwide and from experience on FB and Snapchat, users expect high-quality stickers in every online community they are in.

### **How it works**

1. Sign up on Stipop Dashboard
2. Invite developer and integrate Stipop API or SDK
3. Customize UI and sticker list from the Dashboard
4. Release and see how it affects user engagement

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64303&key=user_uploads/265166/d6b5511b-a239-4d59-aa88-497fcad56663)

### **Why we built Stipop**

We started Stipop to help users express themselves better wherever they were and at the same time provide sticker creators a new way to reach the audience and generate revenue to continue on with their creative journies. 

**Want to start building a sticker feature?** Visit us at <https://stipop.io/>
